content: Event Duration: 48 Hours continuous sprint (Starts: Day 1 at 09:00 AM IST | Ends: Day 3 at 09:00 AM IST). Location: CSE Block, GIETU Gunupur. Opening Ceremony: Day 1 at 09:00 AM – 10:00 AM IST. Hacking Begins: Day 1 at 10:00 AM IST. Catering Schedule: Breakfast 8:00 AM | Lunch 1:00 PM | Dinner 7:00 PM (Lounge C). Lunch Breaks: Daily 01:30 PM – 02:30 PM IST (Block B Cafeteria). Dinner Breaks: Daily 08:00 PM – 09:00 PM IST (Block B Cafeteria). Midnight Snack & Red Bull Call: Day 1 & Day 2 at 12:00 AM (Midnight). Mentorship Hours: Day 1 (02:00 PM – 06:00 PM IST) and Day 2 (10:00 AM – 01:00 PM IST & 04:00 PM – 07:00 PM IST). Submission Deadline: Day 3 strictly at 9:00 AM IST. Demo & Judging Round: Day 3 at 10:30 AM – 01:00 PM IST. Closing & Award Ceremony: Day 3 at 02:00 PM IST.

Team Size: Minimum 2 members, maximum 4 members per team. Solo participants are not permitted to submit projects independently and must use the team-matching portal before Day 1, 12:00 PM IST. Cross-Track Participation: A team can submit a project to only one main track, but is eligible for all general sponsor prize bounties. Participant ID: All participants must carry official student IDs and keep their registration QR badge visible at the on-site venue.

Track 1: AI & Autonomous Agents: Building LLM systems, multi-agent frameworks, RAG workflows, or task automation tooling. Track 2: Web3, Fintech & Decentralized Apps: Smart contracts, decentralized identity, payments, and blockchain security. Track 3: Healthcare & MedTech: Diagnostics tooling, patient management, accessible health tech, and AI medical triage. Track 4: Open Innovation & Smart Campus: Logistics, smart city solutions, IoT, sustainability, and open-source public goods. Track 5: Gen AI.

Originality Policy: All project code, design assets, and workflows must be created during the official 48-hour hackathon window. Pre-existing Code & Open-Source: Third-party open-source libraries, UI components (e.g., Tailwind, Shadcn), APIs, and pre-trained public models (e.g., Hugging Face, OpenAI API) are fully allowed. However, pre-built proprietary applications or repos with commit histories before Day 1 at 10:00 AM IST are strictly disqualified. Use of Generative AI: Using GitHub Copilot, ChatGPT, Claude, and similar code generation tools is permitted for prototyping. Teams must disclose AI assistance in their project README.md. Behavior Policy: Zero tolerance for harassment, offensive language, intellectual property theft, or disruptive behavior.

Wi-Fi Credentials: Network SSID: Hackathon_5G | Password: innovate_2026. Cloud & LLM API Keys: Groq Free Tier active via portal. Gemini API Keys distributed upon verification at Help Desk A. Hardware Lab Access: Microcontrollers (ESP32, Raspberry Pi 4, Arduino kits, and sensor packs) are available at Hardware Desk (Block B Room 104). Maximum 2 devices checked out per team; valid student ID deposit required.

All teams must submit before Day 3 at 9:00 AM IST on the submission portal with the following four deliverables: 1. Public Repository URL: GitHub/GitLab link containing clear setup steps, MIT/Apache 2.0 license, and an updated README.md. 2. Demo Video Link: YouTube or Loom URL (Maximum 3 minutes long, publicly viewable, showcasing working features). 3. Live Deployment / APK Link: Working web URL (e.g., Vercel, Render) or downloadable binary/APK. 4. Presentation Deck: PDF slide deck (Maximum 7 slides covering: Problem, Solution, Architecture, Tech Stack, Business Impact). Note: Submissions missing a public repo link or exceeding the 3-minute video limit will fail automated compliance validation.
Evaluated on a 100-Point Scale. Innovation & Uniqueness: 30%. Technical Execution: 30%. UX & Polish: 20%. Pitch & Impact: 20%.

Emergency Medical / Security: Room 101 Ground Floor | Contact: +91-9876543210. Logistics & Catering Issues: Discord channel #ask-organizers or Help Desk B. Technical & API Troubleshooting: Discord channel #mentor-support or submit ticket through the Concierge bot with urgency High.
